adjudication.rationale: In lib/tasks/disqus.thor, the CLI option `method_option :category, aliases: '-c'` is removed and the associated logic that looked up `category_id` and passed `category: category_id` into `PostCreator.new(...)` is also deleted. The import path now calls `TopicEmbed.import_remote(...)` without any category parameter. This is a verifiable behavioral change that will break existing scripts/automation that call `disqus:import` with `--category` (option no longer recognized) and removes the ability to import into a chosen category via this task.
